question: In what way is the goddess invoked as the embodiment of the four human aims?
premises: The goddess is urgently called to come.
She consists of dharma, wealth, desire, and liberation.
inference: The auspicious goddess is summoned as the very embodiment of all four aims of life.
plain_english: Come, come, O auspicious one, you who consist of dharma, wealth, desire, and liberation.
